summary.text: Stephen Smith is the Libertarian candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An accountant, he ran for the same seat as a Libertarian in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Smith earned a bachelor's degree from West Virginia University in 1980, a graduate degree from West Virginia University in 2003 and a graduate degree from Stetson University in 2010.
His career experience includes working as an accountant.
In the November 8, 2022 general election for District 12, Smith received 295 votes, or 7.5 percent, as the Libertarian candidate; incumbent Republican Vernon Criss won.
In a Ballotpedia survey for 2026, Smith listed state tax reform, responsible school choice and foster care reform among his key messages.
